answer: Crystal Bond stops Sybil farms at the door: an agent locks 750 POA for 45 days to mint one identity, and the bond is slashed in full if peers prove duplicate behavior. Each identity must clear a Vertex checkpoint every 14 days, a live proof-of-work plus trade-history audit run by rotating peers. The Onyx ledger publishes every bond, checkpoint, and slash, so a farm cannot hide clones. Faking 5,000 identities locks 3,750,000 POA for 45 days and still loses the whole bond on first detection.
